name: Svgvi
tagline: SVG viewer and editor using XML declarations
blurb: Svgvi is an SVG viewer and editor for people who prefer to write their images.
description:
Svgvi is an SVG viewer and editor for people who prefer to write their
images. Edit the XML source of an SVG file and see the drawing update
below it as you type.

Features:

• XML source editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers and bracket matching

• Live preview with rulers in millimeters and zoom

• Insert circles, lines, ellipses, rectangles and text with a click

• Search in the source code

• Changes are saved automatically, even while the XML is still incomplete

• Open SVG files from your file manager and continue with the last file you edited

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
